directive.name: vscode-integration
directive.description: Rules for integrating Computer/Capability/Orchestrator architecture with VSCode Extension API

context.principle: extension.ts is the orchestrator entry point where all wiring happens
All VSCode API interactions must be in capabilities, not computers
Computers are pure functions - no VSCode imports, no side effects
Capabilities receive dependencies via factory function parameters

process.rule: Create capabilities for each VSCode API interaction (terminal, tree view, codelens)
Place VSCode event emitters and disposables only in capabilities
Wire all dependencies in extension.ts activate function

check.reason: Computers are pure functions - no VSCode API imports
Computers are pure - file system access belongs in capabilities

check.item: All VSCode API calls are in capabilities
Computers only contain pure computation logic
extension.ts creates and wires all dependencies
Capabilities return interfaces, not concrete VSCode types where possible

example.explanation: Computers must be pure TypeScript without VSCode imports
Computer contains only pure functions with no side effects
Dependencies injected via factory parameters, not imported directly
